$comment: Third-party binaries redistributed in the portable Windows package (tools/package/windows/README.md). build.mjs downloads each file and refuses it unless the SHA-256 matches; tools/licensing/license-gate.mjs checks each license against the allowlist and lists it in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. To update: change version, url and sha256 (from the upstream SHASUMS256.txt / release page) together, and the license text pin too.

binaries.name: Node.js
binaries.role: Runtime of go-go-harmoniyo.exe (Node.js single executable application: node.exe with the game's code injected).
binaries.licenseNote: Node.js's LICENSE also carries the notices of the components built into node.exe (V8, OpenSSL, ICU, libuv, llhttp, …).

binaries.name: cloudflared
binaries.role: Optional quick tunnel (https://….trycloudflare.com) for phones that can't reach the PC on the local network; shipped unmodified next to the exe.
binaries.licenseNote: No NOTICE file upstream. The Go modules compiled into it are listed in its go.mod; their notices are not enumerated in this package (open question in tools/package/windows/README.md).
